name: impact_cinematic
character: A layered cinematic impact: a sub drop below 60 Hz, a pitched body, a beater click, a low thump and a short tail. Click, body, sub and tail are separate layers so each can be tuned on its own.
note: Layer split after trailer-impact practice (click, body, sub, tail; bass under 200 Hz, mids to 2 kHz, highs above), vendor blogs, opinion. Every frequency and time constant is a starting value: tune against the render with realism.sub_weight and realism.impact_attack.
